question: Calculate the amount of liquid (in litres) that can be filled into a hemispherical pot having radius 21 cm. (Take π = 22/7)
solution:
Given:

Radius (r) = 21 cm

Formula Used:

Volume of hemispherical pot, V = (2/3) × π × r3

Calculations:

V = (2/3) × (22/7) × 21 × 21 × 21
